info.title: questlog API
info.description:
A spoiler-free quest log, build tracker and item list for the games you play. The MCP endpoint (/mcp) comes first; this API follows it, over the same data and the same rules: only the signed-in player's own log, and no spoiler unless a request asks for it.

Every error is JSON, `{"error": "...", "code": "..."}`. Besides the responses listed per operation, an unknown path answers 404 (`not_found`), a method an operation doesn't have answers 405 with `Allow`, and a failure on the server's side answers 500 (`internal`) without details.

post.description: The player's words verbatim as transcript, then what was learned from it: quests with their entries, a stat snapshot, the build plan and items. The same as the MCP tool record.

transcript.description: What the player said, verbatim, never a summary. A screenshot they shared: what it shows, written out as text and numbers

summary.description: One or two sentences of what happened in this session, in the player's terms

playthroughId.description: The playthrough, as briefing returns it. Without it, give game

game.description: The game's title, when there is no playthroughId: an unknown title starts a new game and playthrough

platform.description: For a new game: where it is played (Switch 2, PS5, PC)

label.description: Which run of the game: NG, NG+; picks or starts that playthrough

language.description: For a new playthrough: the language the game is played in (de, en)

playedOn.description: The day of the session. Default today

quests.description: Quests the player started, advanced or finished in this session

id.description: An existing quest's id, from briefing or open_threads

name.description: The quest's name, or the NPC's when the game names none. An exact match in the playthrough updates that quest; otherwise a new one starts

localName.description: The name in the game's own language, as the player said it

status.description: open: waiting on the player; blocked: waiting on the game; done, failed, dropped close it. Set done only when the player said they finished it. Default: unchanged, open for a new one

kind.description: log: what the player did or found out; next: the next step, in vague words; decision: a choice the player made

spoiler.description: Default none: what the player found or told. hint when the text names a place, person or item the player hasn't reached; full when it names a boss, an outcome or a story event. A next step from your own knowledge of the game is at least hint

stats.description: A snapshot of the stats, as the player said them or a screenshot shows them

values.description: Each stat by its key, as earlier snapshots name it: { "vitality": 12, "motivity": 20 }

names.description: For a stat the game hasn't had yet: its English and its own name

localName.description: The game's own name for it

build.description: The build plan, when the player set or changed it

mainStat.description: The stat key the build is built around

items.description: Items the player found, equipped or put away

kind.description: weapon, handle, blade, amulet, …, in the game's terms

verdict.description: How it fits the build, with where you know it from

spoiler.description: Default none. hint or full when the verdict names what the player hasn't reached

post.summary: Fix or remove what was filed
post.description: Each change names one row by what and id and sets some of its fields, or removes it; all apply or none. The same as the MCP tool correct.

what.description: The kind of row: game, playthrough, session, quest, entry (a quest's log line), snapshot (stats) or item

id.description: Its id, as briefing, open_threads, item or record returned it

remove.description: Remove it. A game or playthrough takes everything filed in it along; a session its log entries and its snapshot; a quest its entries. Only when the player said so

mergeInto.description: A quest only: the id of the quest it really is. Its entries move there and it is removed. Only after the player agreed

status.description: playthrough: playing, finished, dropped. quest: open, blocked, done, failed, dropped; done only when the player said they finished it

playedOn.description: session (its snapshot moves with it) or snapshot: the day

localName.description: quest or item: the name in the game's own language; null clears it

location.description: quest: where it started; item: where it was found; null clears it

kind.description: entry: log, next, decision. item: weapon, handle, amulet, … in the game's terms; null clears it

spoiler.description: entry or item: none once the player has found what it names

values.description: snapshot: the stats to fix, by key; the others stay

verdict.description: item: how it fits the build, with where you know it from; null clears it
